messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert PD-4321 fired -> resource: redis.cache-cluster-prod-1 metric redis.maxclients >= 99% (alert threshold). Paging channel: #eng-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/pd/PD-4321 :rotating_light:
Alex Chen: acked. I'm taking primary. pulling logs + metric dashboards now.
Ops Bot: Auto-escalation to L2 scheduled in 5m if not acked.
Priya Nair: on standby to take handoff. what's the customer impact?
Alex Chen: quick summary: API gateway 5xx spike ~6% over last 3m, errors contain "ERR max number of clients reached" from redis proxies. latency p50->p95 jumped 300ms->1.9s. redis INFO from one host:
```
connected_clients:1023
maxclients:1024
used_memory:15432123456
```
Action I'm going to try: bump maxclients temporarily and drain bulk workers that hold long-lived conns.
Jamal Ortiz: caution - increasing maxclients can push memory usage. prefer evict large keys + throttle producers first. what does bigkeys show?
Ben Park: running bigkeys scan now, will paste results in a sec.
Ben Park: bigkeys snippet:
```
# db0
key:session:heavy:12345 size:1.2GB type:string
key:embedding:cache:zz size:800MB type:hash
key:bulk:upload:* approx 30 keys >50MB
```
Priya Nair: collateral note: also seeing Postgres connection errors from api-read  group: "FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections" — looks like both caches & db pools hitting limits.
Alex Chen: rolling temporary config change to redis-hosts: `CONFIG SET maxclients 4096` then `SAVE` on a test node, will run on primaries with stagger. command:
```
for h in host1 host2 host3; do redis-cli -h $h CONFIG SET maxclients 4096; done
```
Jamal Ortiz: instead of SAVE (which can block), prefer `BGREWRITEAOF` avoidance — do NOT run RDB save on primaries. If AOF enabled, watch I/O.
Alex Chen: noted. I will avoid SAVE. applying change now and throttling bulk workers via k8s.
Alex Chen: running: `kubectl scale deployment bulk-worker -n prod --replicas=2` -> reduces concurrency.
Priya Nair: I'm slamming rate limiter to block non-essential traffic: `POST /internal/ratelimit` patch applied.
Ben Park: evicting the largest session key (temp) to free memory: `DEL key:session:heavy:12345` -> confirmed freed ~1.2GB. also purged top 20 heavy keys, freed ~12GB total.
Sara Li: PagerDuty note: PD-4321 acknowledged by Alex Chen at 3278901250. Escalation to L2 (Jamal Ortiz) queued if no progress by 3278901550.
Jamal Ortiz: starting graceful eviction policy and enabling LFU eviction on the cluster parameter for short term. command: `CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy volatile-lfu` (will monitor).
Ops Bot: Throttle automation: paused bulk job queue consumers (job-runner-prod) as requested.
Alex Chen: Postgres: added 2 read replicas behind load balancer to absorb read traffic; patched pgbouncer pool sizes up from 100->250 temporarily. commands run: `pgo scale cluster` and `psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = 500"` then `SELECT pg_reload_conf();`
Priya Nair: customer impact update: approx 21 customers reported degraded inference responses, overall request error rate peaked at 6% and is now ~0.9%. Escalation notice drafted for status page: "Investigating: partial performance degradation for LLM inference API affecting a subset of requests". Ready to publish on approval.
Alex Chen: monitoring: redis connected_clients down to ~700 across primaries, p95 latency back to ~320ms, 5xx around 0.8%. Keeping additional mitigations in place for 30m.
Jamal Ortiz: observing memory headroom after evictions; AOF not rewriting, I/O stable. Recommending post-incident tasks: reduce session sizes, investigate embedding cache TTLs, and add cluster autoscale rules.
Ben Park: left a short runbook note in ops-runbooks: "If maxclients reached -> check bigkeys, evict heavy keys, avoid SAVE, increase maxclients only with memory guardrails, throttle producers."
Sara Li: PD update: incident routed to "Mitigated" at 3278901600 by Alex Chen. Preparing for handoff to postmortem owner.
Alex Chen: closing the active pager. Actions: (1) postmortem owner: Priya (2) follow-up: add alerts for combined redis+pg connection surges, write rate-limit safety nets, audit bulk job patterns.
Incident Bot: PD-4321 status: RESOLVED (mitigated).
Priya Nair: taking postmortem. I'll create doc and tag infra, eng-runtime, and product for impact assessment. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
